# blockmodels: Latent and Stochastic Block Model Estimation by a 'V-EM' Algorithm

Latent and Stochastic Block Model estimation by a Variational EM algorithm. Various probability distribution are provided (Bernoulli, Poisson...), with or without covariates.

blockmodels was written by Jean-Benoist Leger, its original author and main developer. If you use it, please cite:

> Jean-Benoist Leger (2016). Blockmodels: A R-package for estimating in Latent Block Model and Stochastic Block Model, with various probability functions, with or without covariates. [arXiv:1602.07587](https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.07587).

(see also `citation("blockmodels")`).

## Installation

The stable version of blockmodels can be installed from CRAN with:

```r
install.packages("blockmodels")
```

The development version can be installed from [GitHub](https://github.com/GrossSBM/blockmodels) with:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("GrossSBM/blockmodels")
```

## Documentation

The package documentation is available on [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=blockmodels) and on the [package website](https://grosssbm.github.io/blockmodels/).
